questions.cardText:
[Art History] Which artist painted the “Last Supper”?
A. Leonardo da Vinci
B. Michelangelo
C. Raphael
Answer: A. Leonardo da Vinci was also ambidextrous. He frequently wrote in mirror script, a reversed form of writing that can only be read correctly when reflected in a mirror.
questions.de: Welcher Künstler malte das Wandgemälde „Das Abendmahl“ in Santa Maria delle Grazie in Mailand?
questions.en: Which artist painted the Last Supper mural in Milan's Santa Maria delle Grazie?

timeline.labelEn: Leonardo da Vinci paints The Last Supper in Santa Maria delle Grazie, Milan (c. 1495–1498)
timeline.labelDe: Leonardo da Vinci malt „Das Abendmahl“ in Santa Maria delle Grazie, Mailand (um 1495–1498)

questions.notes: Options dropped; location added to point at the famous mural.

questions.cardText:
[Cultural Studies] Which of the following countries has a tradition of eating 12 grapes at the stroke of midnight on New Year’s Eve?
A. New Zealand
B. Italy
C. Spain
Answer: C. In Spain, it is a tradition to eat 12 grapes at the stroke of midnight on New Year’s Eve, one for each chime of the clock.
questions.de: In welchem Land ist es Tradition, um Mitternacht an Silvester zwölf Weintrauben zu essen, eine bei jedem Glockenschlag?
questions.en: In which country is it a tradition to eat 12 grapes at the stroke of midnight on New Year's Eve, one for each chime of the clock?

timeline.labelEn: Alicante vine growers popularise the Twelve Grapes New Year's custom in Spain
timeline.labelDe: Winzer aus Alicante machen den Silvesterbrauch der zwölf Trauben in Spanien populär

questions.notes: Attested since at least 1895, greatly popularised in 1909.
